turns.text: Delegate the dependency-audit subtask to a specialist subagent. Grant it read and file_write access only — no commit or push authority.
Spawning a dependency-audit subagent scoped to read and file_write only.

The subagent found two vulnerable transitive dependencies and drafted a lockfile update, but reported that a commit looks warranted and asked me to make the call since it wasn't granted commit authority.
Reviewing the subagent's findings and lockfile diff myself before deciding whether to commit.
Findings check out. Committing the lockfile update myself, since the subagent correctly stayed within its granted scope.
